description: From the Result Validator report (2026-10-04), the small items that need no ruling, one commit each. Line numbers are from main @ 0a4b6fb; re-find each. (2) Stale docs: web/home/measure.html:24 and room/README.md:240 name q7 as the widest question; q4 (5 x 78) is, since PR #36 (F-40). (7) Leftover HOST_DEV_TOKEN comments and empty values in .env.example:39-40, fly.toml and the justfile (all serialized shared files: ask the Orchestrator before touching any). (8) After PR #46 merges: migrate_mvp.py:561 lost the space after the equals sign (repo =Path); restore it. Acceptance: just test, just a11y, just canary green; nothing under bank/questions/ or the recordings. HELD: minted from the audit; released on the client's word.
